conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLA: Resolved only as to current status by the identified later source’s express revocation of the parent order as amended, effective 2003-09-30. This does not establish whether the amended commission had already terminated earlier; its triggering report submission (and any extension) is unproved.

rationale: Provisional NO as of 2026-10-14: EO 13316 §3(c), §6 lists EO 13227 as amended by EO 13255 among completed/terminated commissions and makes the revocation effective September 30, 2003. Earlier first cessation is unresolved: EO 13227 §4(e) says Commission terminates 30 days after submitting its final report unless extended by President. EO 13255 §3(b) changes the due date to July 1, 2002; actual submission date and any extension are not established by sources reviewed. Read later order text and exact held original; status conclusion is separate from whole-lifecycle conclusion.
notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
